source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: Interim results of a phase 2 trial of binimetinib (NCT03231306) in NF1 plexiform neurofibromas report partial response rates of about 70% in children and 65% in adults.
